function: Unsupervised network RISnet configures passive RIS phase shifts to maximize weighted sum rate in multi-user SDMA, combined with analytical WMMSE precoding at the BS (p. 1, 9).
system: Downlink multi-user MISO: 9-antenna BS, 4 single-antenna users, passive reflecting RIS of 36x36 elements with mutual coupling, 3.5 GHz carrier (p. 3, 9).
method: Unsupervised learning: permutation-invariant, GNN-like network RISnet trained by gradient ascent on weighted sum rate, alternating with the WMMSE precoder (p. 5, 9).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing urban-intersection channels, 10,240 training and 1,024 testing samples; variants add i.i.d. scattering gain or use a fully i.i.d. channel (p. 9-10).
test_conditions: Training and test data generated independently in the same setup; one mismatch test: trained without mutual coupling, tested with coupling (p. 10).
baselines: DRL with fully connected network [21] (learned); random phase shift and BCD algorithm [6] (non-learned) (p. 10).
metrics: Weighted sum rate (bit/Hz/s); inference time; asymptotic complexity; number of trainable parameters (p. 10-12).
complexity: RISnet inference O(QPKN), BCD O(U^2 N^2), fully connected DRL O(U N^2); 0.07 s for 1296 elements; about 10^4 parameters (p. 11-12).
q1_support: p. 9: "The open-source DeepMIMO data set [38] is applied to generate" channel data from the DeepMIMO ray-tracing simulator (urban intersection), used for training and for independently generated testing data (p. 9-10).
q2_support: p. 10: "testing RISnet trained without mutual coupling to problem with mutual coupling"
q3_support: p. 10: "deep reinforcement learning (DRL) [21], random phase shift, and BCD algorithm [6] as baselines for comparison"
q4_support: p. 12: "RISnet can configure a RIS with 1296 elements within 0.07 second"
q5_support: p. 12: "Code and data in this paper are available under" the GitHub link https://github.com/bilepeng/risnet_mutual_partial (underscores confirmed on the page image); DeepMIMO is also a public dataset (p. 9).
notes: Passive RIS with mutual coupling (S-parameter model, p. 3-4); hybrid with analytical WMMSE precoding, so the learned function is RIS configuration (area 3). q2 rests on the mutual-coupling mismatch test (p. 10), which shows degradation and no claim of generalization; reviewer to confirm it counts as a new condition. BS antenna count (9) read from the page image of Table I (p. 9). DeepMIMO is public, so q1 and q5 also rest on it. Fig. 9 (p. 11) compares weighted sum rate against all three baselines.
